title: Cost transparency that rides with durable sessions
description: Vision (owner): actual direct model token cost, priced from published vendor prices, per session, bot, message or turn, tool call or loop, and sub-agent, stored with the pi-durable session so it survives handoff, takeover, crash and restart, and stays at parity with durability features. Audit and plan: docs/COST_ACCOUNTING.md (PR 533). Audit result: per-turn token and dollar ledger exists (conversation/src/ledger/vendor-ledger.ts) but is a separate row, has no bot/channel/user, no API, no web view; the computer-owner path appears to count a turn twice (gateway ADD plus finalize ADD); cached input and long-context tier are not priced; sub-agents would be missed. Children: T1 to T10 in the plan. Done when: per-call cost records ride in the session document, API and web show cost by session, bot, message, tool call and sub-agent, parity guard is in CI.

comments.author: home
comments.text: T2 decision: no pi-durable afterResponse hook is used. Cost records are derived from the session entries (assistant message usage) after the fact, keyed idempotently, rather than written from a hook. T1 to T4 (PRs 535 to 538) are merged and verified live on development 2026-10-13. T5 (chatticus-10e4ad) is raised to P0 as next in the queue; T6 to T10 remain open.

right_now_summary: Core cost tracking is live in development; T5 awaits review, while sub-agent, migration, limits, and web work continues.
